successCriteria.description: The test suite renders a balance with non-zero entitledDays (20), usedDays (8), pendingDays (2), and available (10) and asserts all four rendered values ("Entitled: 20", "Used: 8", "Pending: 2", "Available: 10") appear in the document, plus the period dates rendered via formatUtcDate output ("2025-01-01" and "2025-12-31").

The test suite renders with getBalances resolving to [] and asserts the explicit "No balances yet" message is present AND the loading text ("Loading…") is NOT present, proving the empty state is distinct from loading.

The test suite renders with getBalances rejecting (new Error('balances failed')) while getMe resolves, and asserts a role="alert" element containing "balances failed" is shown AND the loading text is absent, proving the page is not stuck in the loading state.
The existing approvals-link tests (MANAGER shows link, ADMIN shows link, EMPLOYEE does not) remain intact and passing, and `vitest run` plus `tsc --noEmit && vite build` both pass after the edit.

constraints: Modify ONLY web/src/presentation/pages/DashboardPage.test.tsx; do not change DashboardPage.tsx, shared/types, shared/date, or any module source.
Keep the existing approvals-link tests intact; extend the suite rather than replacing it.
Reuse the existing buildBalance/buildProfile fixtures and the renderPage helper (extend it or add a variant accepting a balances array and/or a rejecting getBalances).
Use await screen.findBy... async assertions; do not assert only `available` in the full-breakdown test.
outOfScope: No changes to DashboardPage.tsx, shared/types, shared/date, or any module/backend source — this phase is test-only.
No new routes, pages, or backend/API changes; no new date parsing or second formatter.

consistencyRequirements.requirement:
Assertions must match the actual rendered markup and text of DashboardPage.tsx: error state is
{error}
with raw err.message; loading state is
Loading…
; empty state is

No balances yet

; balance items render {leaveTypeCode} ({periodStart} to {periodEnd}) with nested Entitled/Used/Pending/Available list items.

Fixture field names and types must match the canonical LeaveBalanceView (id, employeeId, leaveTypeCode, periodStart, periodEnd, entitledDays, usedDays, pendingDays, available) and LeaveTypeCode.ANNUAL === 'annual'.
Date assertions must use formatUtcDate output (YYYY-MM-DD via en-CA/UTC), so new Date('2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z') renders '2025-01-01' and new Date('2025-12-31T00:00:00.000Z') renders '2025-12-31'.
